markers=[(0,2),(2,5),(2,8),(4,9),(6,2),(6,5),(6,8),(8,1),(8,6),(10,9),(10,10)]
# Panels occupy coordinates 0..2, 4..6, and 8..10 on each axis.
def panel_coord(x):
    return 0 if x <= 2 else 1 if 4 <= x <= 6 else 2 if 8 <= x <= 10 else None
counts=[[0]*3 for _ in range(3)]
shapes=[[[] for _ in range(3)] for _ in range(3)]
for r,c in markers:
    pr,pc=panel_coord(r),panel_coord(c)
    if pr is None or pc is None: raise ValueError((r,c))
    counts[pr][pc]+=1
    shapes[pr][pc].append((r%4,c%4))
print({'marker_total':len(markers),'panel_counts':counts,'panel_local_coords':shapes,'exactly_two_panels':[(r,c) for r in range(3) for c in range(3) if counts[r][c]==2]})
